Best Internet Deals of the Week: Sept. 14

The weather is cooling down, but the internet savings are as hot as ever

The temperatures are dropping, pumpkin spice season is in full swing, but the internet savings are still hot and only getting hotter. We’ve got something for our NFL fans, military families, and anyone who simply likes a good deal. Read on to start saving.

Act fast! These deals won’t last long

These deals are a real win, but they’re running on borrowed time. The best deals a provider has to offer tend to have the shortest deadlines,  but they’re beyond worthwhile if you’re ready to make the investment.

Get a $200 Amazon Gift Card when you sign up with Verizon*

New Verizon customers who sign up for a Verizon Fios gigabit plan online can get an Amazon gift card worth up to $200. Between the fast speeds, Verizon’s wide digital footprint, and the bonus $200 to put towards online shopping, you can’t go wrong. But take advantage of the savings while you can! This deal’s only available until Sept. 16

Get Verizon Now for Verizon Home Internet

* See Verizon disclaimer.

Save 50% on an NFL Sunday Ticket with Xfinity*

You can stream the regular 2026 season with Xfinity ‘s fiber Wi-Fi and score NFL Sunday tickets on YouTube for 50% off. As long as you sign up before Oct. 28, you’ll be fully prepped to catch all the action.

Get Xfinity Now for Xfinity

* See Xfinity disclaimer.

The best deal of the week!

Get free Airpods 4 and 1 mo. of service on T-Mobile*

This deal takes our top spot of the week for a few reasons: quality internet starting at only $35 a month, one free month of service, and a free pair of Airpods 4 thrown into the mix.

Between the worthwhile freebies and T-Mobile ’s widespread availability, it’s one of the most accessible deals available right now. Don’t wait; it’s only available through Oct. 7. 

Get T-Mobile Now for T-Mobile Home Internet

* See T-Mobile disclaimer.

Extended offers (with exceptional value)

Extended offers are for the top deals that grant you a longer timeline to sign up. They’re just as good, but have a little more wiggle room w to make your purchase official. That being said, even if there’s no expiration date now, providers can still make changes without warning. So take your time, but if you know you want the deal, sign up while you still can.

Get Mediacom Xtream Connect for $29.99/mo.*

Military members and veterans can sign up for Mediacom Xtream Connect for $29.99 per month, and lock in that price for five full years. Mediacom doesn’t have the widest availability, but if you can get it in your area, it’s a great way to access reliable internet at a discounted rate. There’s no deadline we were able to track down, but if you qualify, we suggest you don’t wait to sign up.

Get Mediacom Now for Mediacom AQS Plans for Mediacom

* See Mediacom disclaimer.

FAQ about deals

How can you get a deal?

Ready to save? Usually, all it takes is a visit to the provider’s site. Pick the plan associated with the deal you want and move through the checkout process. Often, the best deals are easily available, but don’t worry if you don’t see your deal from the get-go. Many providers actually wait until you’ve entered your address and started the checkout process to reveal your final rate.

We strongly recommend you take a quick look at the fine print before you hit confirm—just in case you missed anything throughout the process.

Methodology

We reviewed the most recent deals available from different providers, paying attention to overall value to make it easy to find the plan that best fits your internet needs. We researched and categorized these offers into limited-time and long-term internet deals to narrow down the best available options. Limited-time deals need to be signed up for quickly because the eligibility window is shorter, whereas long-term deals give you more flexibility in order to really decide what best fits your needs.
